description: In a tarot spread, each position asks its own question. See how the same card changes meaning from past to present to advice, and how to read by position.
lede: Where a card lands in a tarot spread decides which question it answers, so the same card can read differently each time.

same-card.alt: Three identical gold-edged tarot cards in three panels under the heading One card, three positions. The panels are labelled Past, what led here; Present, what is happening now; and Advice, what could help.
same-card.caption: The same card in three positions. Each position asks a different question, so the card is read three different ways.
